mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notice_status SNS INNER JOIN sys_notice SN ON SNS.notice_id = SN.id AND SN.`status` = 1 WHERE read_status = 0 AND user_id = #{userName}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_todo ST WHERE ST.status = 0 AND ST.user_name = #{userName}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log_login LL WHERE LL.status = 1 AND LL.login_time >= #{beginTime}

SELECT SN.id, SN.title, SNS.id AS notice_status_id, SN.create_time FROM sys_notice SN INNER JOIN sys_notice_status SNS ON SN.id = SNS.notice_id WHERE SN.`status` = 1 AND SNS.read_status = 0 AND SNS.user_id = #{userName} ORDER BY SN.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ST.id, ST.title, ST.priority, ST.due_date, ST.create_time FROM sys_todo ST WHERE ST.status = 0 AND ST.user_name = #{userName} ORDER BY ST.priority ASC, ST.due_date ASC, ST.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(LL.login_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM log_login LL WHERE LL.status = 1 AND LL.login_time >= #{beginTime} AND LL.login_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(LL.login_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
